The fix is to use `Math.round()` to ensure we get an integer. Let me also check and fix the similar issue in `decimalCommaToCents`:

content.text:
I've fixed the issue! The problem was floating-point precision when converting prices to cents. The code was doing `39.95 * 100` which produces `3995.0000000000005` instead of the integer `3995`. 

I added `Math.round()` to three functions in the money handling code to ensure we always get whole cents. The fix works — you can now add subscriptions at 39.95, 12.99, 10.99, and any other normal price.

Can I commit these changes?
